analysis:
## Technical analysis

**Trend:** Near-term corrective within long-term bull structure. June 24 closed at $200.81, holding above the critical $200 floor for the second consecutive session. The Annual Meeting did not produce the expected 5–8% move because macro headwinds (VIX 19.49, DXY 101.59) kept buyers disciplined. AH move to $205+ on Micron beat is the session's real verdict.

**Momentum:** RSI ~50–52 post-flat June 24 session. The AH gap to $205 on Micron beat sets up Thursday with momentum building from below toward the 50-DMA.

**Volume:** ~30–35M shares on June 24 — below the 151.94M average but above June 23's 24.41M. Market participants held positions through the Annual Meeting event. Thursday gap-up open will confirm whether institutional volume returns.

**Strongest support — $200 (★):** Three consecutive tests held: (1) June 23 intraday $200.04; (2) June 24 overnight premarket; (3) June 24 regular session low ~$199. The floor is confirmed.

**Strongest resistance — 50-DMA ~$207:** First recovery target on Thursday gap-up + cold PCE. If SPX recovers through 7,460 on Thursday, NVDA breaking above $207 triggers the 200-DMA (~$213) as the next target.

**Decision point:** Thursday open above $205 is the conditional add trigger. Stop $195 two-close basis unchanged. PCE at 8:30 AM ET is the macro arbiter — cold PCE extends the rally; hot PCE creates a same-day reversal opportunity.
